
### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

fast and low cpu usage in tidb

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

hig cpu usage

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/528332/124555118-4aa21280-de69-11eb-9e67-28e4a0014069.png)
